features.text: FRACTURE AND SPRAIN STABILIZATION: Tall frame supports foot, ankle, and lower leg during recovery.
EVEN STRAP CONTROL: Adjustable strapping system accommodates swelling and dressings for a secure fit.
BREATHABLE AIRMESH LINER: Moisture managing liner improves comfort during extended wear.
ROCKER BOTTOM GAIT: Dual axis sole promotes a more natural walking pattern while healing.
FSA HSA ELIGIBLE: Use your Flexible Spending or Health Savings Account for this purchase.
PDAC APPROVED L4387, L4386: Eligible for insurance reimbursement (check with your provider).
PERFECT FIT GUARANTEE: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with our U.S.-based specialists.
